attempts.text: [{"name": "wk_after_buy", "idea": "Current-week directed purchase follow-through: for the last 3 distinct prefix items, the share of target-week prefixes holding the item in which the candidate was carted or ordered (and ordered only) after the item's first occurrence, recency-weighted and integer-exact.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), lt AS (SELECT session, item, rp FROM pr WHERE rp <= 3), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), a AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, min(x.seq) AS fq FROM sess x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item GROUP BY x.session, x.item), dn AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS tot FROM a GROUP BY item), bb AS (SELECT session, item, seq, event FROM sess WHERE event <> 'view'), pc AS (SELECT a.item AS src, bb.item AS dst, count(DISTINCT bb.session) AS c, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bb.event = 'order' THEN bb.session END) AS co FROM a JOIN bb ON bb.session = a.session AND bb.item <> a.item AND bb.seq > a.fq GROUP BY a.item, bb.item), sc AS (SELECT lt.session, pc.dst AS item, sum(CAST(round(1000000.0 * pc.c / (dn.tot + 2.0)) AS BIGINT) * (4 - lt.rp)) AS v, sum(CAST(round(1000000.0 * pc.co / (dn.tot + 2.0)) AS BIGINT) * (4 - lt.rp)) AS vo FROM lt JOIN pc ON pc.src = lt.item JOIN dn ON dn.item = lt.item GROUP BY lt.session, pc.dst) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(sc.v AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 AS ag_wk_after_buy_p, CAST(sc.vo AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 AS ag_wk_after_ord_p FROM cand c LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.session = c.session AND sc.item = c.item;"}, {"name": "wk_cos_rank", "idea": "Session-relative version of the strongest affinity signal: within-session rank of each candidate by the recency-weighted current-week co-visitation cosine from the last 5 distinct prefix items, and its ratio to the session's best value.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), lt AS (SELECT session, item, rp FROM pr WHERE rp <= 5), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), a AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq FROM sess x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item), pc AS (SELECT a.item AS src, y.item AS dst, count(DISTINCT y.session) AS c FROM a JOIN sess y ON y.session = a.session AND y.item <> a.item AND y.seq BETWEEN a.seq - 5 AND a.seq + 5 GROUP BY a.item, y.item), ns AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS n FROM a GROUP BY item), ci AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM cand), nd AS (SELECT s.item, count(DISTINCT s.session) AS n FROM sess s JOIN ci ON ci.item = s.item GROUP BY s.item), q AS (SELECT lt.session, pc.dst AS item, lt.rp, pc.c / sqrt(CAST(ns.n AS DOUBLE) * CAST(nd.n AS DOUBLE)) AS cs FROM lt JOIN pc ON pc.src = lt.item JOIN ns ON ns.item = lt.item JOIN nd ON nd.item = pc.dst), g AS (SELECT session, item, sum(CAST(round(1000000.0 * cs) AS BIGINT) * (6 - rp)) AS sm FROM q GROUP BY session, item), j AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, g.sm FROM cand c LEFT JOIN g ON g.session = c.session AND g.item = c.item), r AS (SELECT session, item, sm, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY coalesce(sm, -1) DESC, item) AS rk, max(sm) OVER (PARTITION BY session) AS mx FROM j) SELECT session, item, CASE WHEN sm IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(rk AS DOUBLE) END AS ag_wk_cos_rk, CASE WHEN sm IS NULL OR mx IS NULL OR mx = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(sm AS DOUBLE) / CAST(mx AS DOUBLE) END AS ag_wk_cos_rel FROM r;"}, {"name": "knn_hist_any", "idea": "Session kNN over 7-day history for any interaction: overlap-weighted count of neighbor history sessions (sharing at least 2 of the last 10 distinct prefix items) that touched the candidate at all, and its share of the session's total neighbor overlap, aimed at the next-view signal.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), lt AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp <= 10), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM lt), si AS (SELECT DISTINCT x.session, x.item FROM hist x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item WHERE x.ts >= {S} - 7*86400), df AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n FROM si GROUP BY item), kq AS (SELECT si.session, si.item FROM si JOIN df ON df.item = si.item WHERE df.n <= 5000), nb AS (SELECT lt.session, kq.session AS ns, count(*) AS ov FROM lt JOIN kq ON kq.item = lt.item GROUP BY lt.session, kq.session HAVING count(*) >= 2), tot AS (SELECT session, sum(ov) AS t FROM nb GROUP BY session), nq AS (SELECT DISTINCT ns FROM nb), ni AS (SELECT DISTINCT x.session, x.item FROM hist x JOIN nq ON nq.ns = x.session WHERE x.ts >= {S} - 7*86400), sc AS (SELECT nb.session, ni.item, sum(nb.ov) AS v FROM nb JOIN ni ON ni.session = nb.ns GROUP BY nb.session, ni.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(sc.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_knn_h_any, CASE WHEN sc.v IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (sc.v + 0.1) / (tot.t + 2.0) END AS ag_knn_h_any_sh FROM cand c LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.session = c.session AND sc.item = c.item LEFT JOIN tot ON tot.session = c.session;"}, {"name": "p_centrality", "idea": "Intent centrality of prefix items: integer-exact sum of 14-day co-visitation cosine and of buy cosine from the item to the other last 20 distinct prefix items, so items at the core of the session's interest are separated from stray clicks.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH pi AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, max(s.seq) AS ls FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session, s.item), pr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY ls DESC, item) AS rp FROM pi), pt AS (SELECT session, item FROM pr WHERE rp <= 20), pp AS (SELECT a.session, a.item, b.item AS oi FROM pt a JOIN pt b ON b.session = a.session AND b.item <> a.item), cc AS (SELECT pp.session, pp.item, sum(CAST(round(c.tv_cos * 1000000) AS BIGINT)) AS v FROM pp JOIN tb_covis14_cos c ON c.item = pp.item AND c.item2 = pp.oi GROUP BY pp.session, pp.item), bc AS (SELECT pp.session, pp.item, sum(CAST(round(b.tv_cos * 1000000) AS BIGINT)) AS v FROM pp JOIN tb_buy_cos14 b ON b.item = pp.item AND b.item2 = pp.oi GROUP BY pp.session, pp.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, CASE WHEN pi.item IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(coalesce(cc.v, 0) AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 END AS ag_p_cent_cos, CASE WHEN pi.item IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(coalesce(bc.v, 0) AS DOUBLE) / 1000000.0 END AS ag_p_cent_bcos FROM cand c LEFT JOIN pi ON pi.session = c.session AND pi.item = c.item LEFT JOIN cc ON cc.session = c.session AND cc.item = c.item LEFT JOIN bc ON bc.session = c.session AND bc.item = c.item;"}, {"name": "dwell_anchor", "idea": "Affinity to the prefix item the shopper spent the most time on (total capped dwell), via 14-day co-visitation cosine, an anchor distinct from the last, entry and most-clicked items.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.ts, lead(x.ts) OVER (PARTITION BY x.session ORDER BY x.seq, x.item, x.event) AS nt FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), g AS (SELECT session, item, sum(CASE WHEN nt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE least(nt - ts, 600) END) AS dw, max(seq) AS ls FROM s GROUP BY session, item), r AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY dw DESC, ls DESC, item) AS rk FROM g), d1 AS (SELECT session, item FROM r WHERE rk = 1), a AS (SELECT d1.session, c.item2 AS item, c.tv_cos AS v FROM d1 JOIN tb_covis14_cos c ON c.item = d1.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, a.v AS ag_dwell_cos14 FROM cand c LEFT JOIN a ON a.session = c.session AND a.item = c.item;"}]
